title: Add missing telemetry event IDs to E-Document Session.LogMessage calls
summary: Added missing telemetry event IDs to 21 Session.LogMessage calls in E-Document and Avalara connector apps to enable proper aggregation and monitoring in the telemetry pipeline.
key_points: Allocated 21 unique telemetry event IDs (0000UVW - 0000UWG) to untagged Session.LogMessage calls
Avalara connector was previously invisible in telemetry queries by event ID despite 20 logging calls
Core E-Document PEPPOL handler had one additional missing event tag
Tags were centrally reserved to prevent collision risk
Enables standard telemetry pipeline filtering and alerting by event ID
